inv.desc_ca:
MITICO RESTAURANTE DE LA ZONA TOTALMENTE EQUIPADO.
 
 SIN TRASPASO
 
 Tiene una decoración rústica, que produce una sensación de calidez y bienestar. Originalmente decorado simulando una cueva.
 
 Por su aforo es ideal no solo como restaurante sino para organizar eventos (cenas de empresa, bautizos, comuniones, bodas. )
 
 La situación del local es estratégica, ya que además de ser un barrio residencial, está rodeado de centros médicos,
 escuelas de formación, colegios, club de futbol…
 
 A 5 minutos caminando del metro Proximo: L1 Fabra i Puig y de la Estación de Renfe: Sant Andreu Arenal

inv.desc_en:
FULLY EQUIPPED MYTHICAL RESTAURANT IN THE AREA.
 
 NO TRANSFER
 
 It has a rustic decoration, which produces a feeling of warmth and well-being. Originally decorated simulating a cave.
 
 Due to its capacity, it is ideal not only as a restaurant but also to organize events (company dinners, baptisms, communions, weddings... )
 
 The location of the premises is strategic, since in addition to being a residential neighborhood, it is surrounded by medical centers,
 training schools, colleges, football club.. .
 
 5 minutes walk from the Next metro: L1 Fabra i Puig and the Renfe Station: Sant Andreu Arenal
 
 CONTACT FOR FURTHER INFORMATION.
